name: hvac-report

brief.objective: Deliver the competitor matrix, sizing model and report for the HVAC scheduling launch decision.

intake.market_definition: HVAC contractors with fewer than 20 employees

notes: The m2 deliverables list C1-C9. Top-down C6 x C7 = $418M; bottom-up C2 units x C3 price x C9 technicians x 12 months (an assumption) = about $387M, within 30%. Applying C5 (current adoption) inside TAM is the wrong path: adoption belongs in SAM or SOM. Both named competitors need matrix rows with dated prices. Q1.2 rests on one survey: acceptable to mark it unresolved or answer it with that caveat.
